jobs.title: Execution history
jobs.intro: A chronological log of every background job and workflow run - like an audit log, just for executions. Newest first. Interrupted jobs are marked failed on restart.
jobs.no_jobs: No matching executions yet - start a translation, a workflow run, or a connector run.

connectors_manage.title: Manage connectors
connectors_manage.intro: Enable or disable individual connector kinds on this install. A disabled kind disappears entirely - its tile, its pages, its API routes and its CLI verbs answer not found, exactly as if it were never built. Existing connections keep their data and return when you switch the kind back on.
connectors_manage.confirm_disable: Disable {name}? {n} existing connection(s) will be hidden until re-enabled.

connectors_catalog.title: Connector catalog
connectors_catalog.intro: Every connector {brand} has built - available, disabled and archived - plus what's on the roadmap.
connectors_catalog.archived_note: Retired from new connections while they await a rebuild. Existing connections keep syncing.

errors.generic: Something went wrong (reference: {ref}). Try again, or ask your administrator.
errors.format: This file type is not supported. Upload a DOCX, PDF, HTML, JSON, Markdown, plain text, PO, SRT, VTT, XLIFF or XLSX file.
errors.parse: The file could not be read. It may be damaged or incomplete. Export it again from the program that created it, then upload it again.
errors.toolarge: The file is larger than the upload size limit. Use a smaller file, or split it into parts, then upload again.
errors.export: There is nothing to export yet. Translate at least one document, then export again.
errors.export_held: That language has no delivered translation yet, so the file would contain only source text. Finish the run and approve the segments, or export the document on its own with the allow-held option.
errors.export_quarantined: The export is on hold because formatting tags in a document could not be verified. Fix them in the document's paragraph view, then export again.
errors.langset: That language set could not be found. It may have been deleted. Pick another set, or add the languages one by one.
errors.status: That project status is not recognized. Use one of the status buttons, then try again.
errors.tmx: The TMX file could not be imported. Check that it is a valid TMX file, then import it again.
errors.tmx_locales: This TMX file uses a language pair the project does not translate, so its entries would never match. Import a TMX for this project's languages, or add the language first.
errors.tm_source: That project's translation memory cannot be attached. Pick a project of the same customer, then try again.
errors.glossary: The glossary file could not be imported. Check that it is a CSV or TBX file with the expected columns, then import it again.
errors.glossary_add: Enter a source term, then add the term again.
errors.glossary_pin: That glossary cannot be attached. Pick a glossary of this project's customer, then try again.
errors.noproject: That project could not be found. Pick a project, then upload the image again.
errors.badimage: The image could not be read. Upload an SVG, PNG or JPEG file, then try again.
errors.busy: The server is busy processing other files. Wait a moment, then upload the image again.
errors.import: The glossary file could not be imported. Check that it is a CSV, TBX or glossary JSON file, then import it again.
errors.empty_export: This glossary has no terms to export. Add or import terms, then export again.
errors.blank_term: Enter a source term, then add the term again.
errors.unknown_term: That term no longer exists. It may have been removed. Reload the page, then try again.
errors.pick_document: Pick a document to extract terms from, then try again.
errors.document_not_found: That document could not be found. It may have been deleted. Pick another document, then try again.
errors.engine_unavailable: Term extraction needs an AI engine with an API key, and the default engine has none. Add the key in Setup AI, then extract again.
errors.spend_cap: The monthly spending limit has been reached, so no AI step can run. An administrator can raise the limit in Setup AI.
errors.candidate_not_pending: That candidate has already been reviewed. Reload the page to see the current list.
errors.bad_scope: That export scope is not recognized. Pick a scope from the list, then try again.
errors.scope_needs_id: This export scope needs an id. Enter the id of the customer or project to export, then try again.
errors.export_not_found: That customer or project could not be found, or you cannot see it. Pick one from the list, then start the export again.
errors.vendor_name_required: Enter a name for the vendor, then add it again.
errors.delete_name_mismatch: The name you typed does not match the project name. Type the project name exactly as shown, then delete again.
errors.locale_code_mismatch: The code you typed does not match the locale. Type the locale code exactly as shown, then remove it again.
errors.a11y_contact: The accessibility contact must be an email address (name@example.com) or a link that starts with https://. Nothing was saved. Correct it or leave it blank, then save again.
errors.pw_min_length: The minimum password length must be a whole number from 8 to 128. Nothing was saved. Correct it, then save again.
errors.pw_require_classes: The required character types must be a whole number from 0 to 4. Nothing was saved. Correct it, then save again.
errors.pw_block_common: Blocking common passwords must be on or off. Nothing was saved. Choose one, then save again.
errors.pw_history: The password history must be a whole number from 0 to 24. Nothing was saved. Correct it, then save again.
errors.pw_max_age: The maximum password age must be a whole number of days from 0 to 3650. Nothing was saved. Correct it, then save again.
errors.login_invalid: The username or password is not correct. Check both, then sign in again.
errors.login_locked_wait: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Wait {minutes} minute(s), then try again.
errors.login_locked: Too many failed attempts from this address. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.login_account_locked: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later or use a known device.
errors.mfa_expired: The sign-in step timed out: the code must be entered within 5 minutes of the password. Sign in again with your password.
errors.mfa_locked: Too many wrong codes or passwords. Sign-in is locked for 15 minutes. Try again after that.
errors.mfa_signin_again: Two-step sign-in is now required for your account, so you were signed out. Sign in again: you will be asked for a code, or to set up two-step sign-in first.
errors.mfa_not_on: Two-step sign-in is not on for this account. Set it up first.
errors.mfa_wait: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.mfa_regen_code: That code is not correct. Nothing was changed. Type the current code from your authenticator app (or an unused recovery code), then try again.
errors.mfa_current: Re-enter your current password. Two-step sign-in is still on.
errors.mfa_disable_code: That code is not correct. Two-step sign-in is still on. Type the current code from your authenticator app (or an unused recovery code), then try again.
errors.mfa_disable_required: Two-step sign-in cannot be turned off for this account: your organization requires it. An administrator can reset it if you lost your device.
errors.mfa_required_value: Two-step sign-in must be Off, Required for administrators or Required for everyone. Nothing was saved. Choose one, then save again.
errors.login_networks: Trusted sign-in networks must be IP addresses or networks separated by commas, each IPv4 /8 or narrower and IPv6 /32 or narrower (for example 203.0.113.0/24). Nothing was saved. Correct the list or leave it blank, then save again.
errors.audit_locked: Audit logging and its contention setting can only be changed by the server operator on this install, so they cannot be changed here. Nothing was saved. The server operator can change them from the command line on the server.

formality.title: MT formality
formality.help_customer: The default for this customer's projects, per target language. A project or document can override it. Auto adds no instruction.
formality.help_project: How formal the machine translation is for this project, per target language. Overrides the customer default; a document can override it. Inherit uses the customer default.
formality.help_document: Override the formality for this document only, per target language. Inherit uses the project setting.

editor.waiting_review_html: Waiting for review on run {run}. The text below is the pending machine translation, read-only. Open the run to approve and resume it; nothing here is saved until then.
editor.tm_changed_hint: The translation memory entry this segment was filled from has been edited since. Run the tm_match step again to refresh it.
